name: Akuma Seijo ~Demon Girl Step~
original_name: 悪魔聖女 ～デーモンガール・ステップ～
source:
Ruti is a demon who was vanquished a long time ago and a part of him was sealed away. Now in the present, he was resurrected by the pitiful Kyouka who mistakened him for a sex toy. He hatched a plan to train her as the evil mahou shoujo Dark Cherry and collect magical energy to fully regain his form. However, three figures of justice stood in their way: mahou shoujos Melody Queen, Lionel and Aya.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2018/11/26/november-2018-eroge-releases//]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
露蒂是很久以前被打败的恶魔，他的一部分被封印了。如今，他被可怜的镜花误认为是性玩具而复活了。他制定了一个计划，将她训练为邪恶的魔法少女黑樱桃，并收集魔法能量以完全恢复他的形态。然而，三位正义人物挡在了他们的面前：魔法少女Melody Queen、莱昂内尔和绫。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2018/11/26/november-2018-eroge-releases//]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
